+## Summary
+
+Increase the pricing cache TTL from 900 seconds (15 minutes) to 3600 seconds (1 hour). This reduces cache miss overhead and improves pricing lookup performance for stable pricing data.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Raised `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 in `pricing_cache.py`
+- Removed unused `lookup()` function that was no longer needed
+
+## Rationale
+
+The longer cache window reduces unnecessary cache refreshes when pricing data remains stable, decreasing load on the pricing feed and improving response times for repeated lookups within the hour window.
